summary: A Ledger user reported receiving a realistic physical mail letter that instructed recipients to scan a QR code for a supposed quantum resistance security update. The letter used Ledger branding and referenced owned devices to pressure recipients into interacting with a malicious update process.
user_mistake: Trusted a mailed security update request without verifying through official channels
prevention: Access Ledger updates only through the official Ledger application/Ignore mailed QR code update instructions requesting wallet actions
